relations: Her torso and head lean forward and down as both hands lower the gray strap, then rise back upright as the strap returns near-vertical.
The half-kneeling lunge stance stays fixed, with right shin on the mat and left foot planted under the strap's lower loop.
The strap's angle shifts from vertical toward the mat during the lean and back to vertical during the rise.
Background foam roller, kettlebell, and dumbbells remain stationary while the lean-and-return cycle continues.
caption: The video depicts a woman in a teal sports bra, light-gray leggings and white sneakers holding a half-kneeling lunge on a patterned yoga mat, right shin on the floor, left foot planted forward. She grips the top of a flat gray strap with both hands, its lower end looped under her front foot. Her torso and head tilt forward and down, gaze dropping toward the planted foot as her hands lower and the strap angles toward the mat. After reaching a rounded, head-down position, she draws her upper body upright again, raising her hands so the strap returns to near-vertical. The lunge stance and foot placement stay fixed, the only motion being this continuous lean and rise. A green foam roller and gray kettlebell rest at the left wall, while yellow and pink dumbbells lie on the floor to the right, all unchanged. The framing is static. The lean-and-return sequence is underway at the first frame and ongoing at the last.
